Hi all — quick answers and materials we can share externally: 

1) SOC 2 Type II
   - Attestation date: 2025-11-01 (covers hosted API and Dedicated pools; Private deployments require customer-specific review but controls map).
   - We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted sensitive infra details) to Acme under our standard NDAs.

2) HIPAA / BAA
   - Redwood supports HIPAA workloads via Private deployments and a BAA can be executed for enterprise customers.
   - For hosted API customers we require a scoping review; BAA approval is handled by Legal. Rishi / Marissa — please loop Legal if Acme wants a BAA.

3) Pen test report and executive summary
   - We have a third-party pen test (Q4 2025). We can share an executive summary (redacted CVEs and IP-specific details) immediately.
   - Full report: available under NDA / controlled access only. Provide NDA template and we’ll gate with secure transfer (S3 link + short-term token).

4) Vulnerability management (what to share with Acme) — proposed external-facing wording:
   - Scanning cadence: weekly automated external scans + weekly internal authenticated scans for critical infra; quarterly authenticated scans for application stack; annual third-party penetration test.
   - Remediation SLAs: Critical (RCE / unauthenticated write) — 7 days; High — 30 days; Medium — 90 days; Low — tracked in backlog. Prioritization is based on CVSS + exploitability.
   - Disclosure: coordinated disclosure process; we notify impacted customers within 48 hours of confirmed critical findings and will publish public advisories after a 90-day coordinated disclosure window unless an immediate public notice is required.
   - Patch & deploy: for infra/config issues we aim to patch and deploy within SLA windows; for vendor/third-party issues we coordinate cross-vendor timelines.

5) Attachments we can share now: SOC2-Type2-Redwood-2025.pdf (redacted), PenTest-Summary-Redwood-2025.pdf (exec summary), Vendor-Security-Questionnaire-Acme-completed.xlsx (partial answers)

Suggested next steps (external-facing):
  - Send SOC2 + pen test exec summary to Acme and offer NDA for full report.
  - Schedule technical session: Wed 2026-03-31 10:00 AM PT (Neha + Vivek) or Thu 2026-04-01 11:00 AM PT.
  - Rishi to coordinate Legal for BAA template if Acme requests HIPAA coverage.

If you want, I can paste a short paragraph for procurement describing our vuln mgmt cadence to drop into the questionnaire.

—Neha
